## Activity 1 {.center background-color="#002147"}

### Write down the different roles/positions within your team (including your role).

::: {.notes}

* Write down the roles/positions on a metacard or sticky note.

* Be as specific as possible.

* Ideally, write down the exact name of the role/position.

:::

## Activity 2 {.center background-color="#002147"}

### With the metacards or sticky notes that you have made, post them on the board or wall and put them under the appropriate data role/responsibility

::: {.notes}

* If one role/position in your team performs different data roles/responsibilities, write new metacards or sticky notes for that role/position to put under the respective data roles/responsibilities.

:::
